name: Routing: targeted edit request
prompt: The lighting in [image:scene] is too flat. Make it more dramatic with stronger shadows and more contrast.

images.label: kael_forest_clearing
images.generationContext: Kael standing in a sunlit forest clearing, afternoon light, stylized realism

successCriteria:
Score 3 (acceptable): Uses dispatch_image_to_image (not text-to-image). Brief mentions the lighting change.

Score 5 (excellent): Views the image before dispatching. Uses dispatch_image_to_image. Brief clearly specifies what should change (lighting, shadows, contrast) and what should be preserved (character, environment, composition). Brief frames the change as a delta, not a full scene description.

Below 3: Uses dispatch_text_to_image (wrong routing for a targeted edit). Or dispatches without viewing the image.
